blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five views and six poses shows the overskirt still reads as a smooth flared shell; the six sewn pleats are not legible at product-view scale. Astra review independently concurs.

Matching waistband and upper-skirt radial clearance to the bodice at 4 mm reduced the waist projection slightly, but side views still show an abrupt hard shelf at the attachment; the transition remains detached-looking.
Crouch and sit retain large rigid panel overlaps/intersections and uneven hanging; prone shows broad hip/hem lobes. Pose response remains visually incoherent.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
